	The Purchase Officer is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing goods and services required by the organization while ensuring quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.

Key Responsibilities


	Identify and evaluate suppliers based on quality, price, delivery, and service.

	Prepare and process Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs).

	Coordinate with stores, operations, kitchen, and accounts departments.
	Maintain supplier records and develop strong vendor relationships.
	Compare market prices and conduct cost-saving initiatives.
	Ensure purchased items meet quality standards and specifications.
	Resolve supplier issues related to deliveries, shortages, and quality concerns.
	Maintain accurate procurement documentation and reports.
	Track inventory levels and support replenishment planning.
	Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.

	Cost savings achieved through negotiations.
	On-time delivery performance.
	Vendor performance ratings.
	Inventory availability and stock control.
	Accuracy of procurement documentation.
	Reduction in purchase-related discrepancies.

	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
	2-5+ years of experience in purchasing / procurement.
	Experience in hospitality, catering, food service, or FMCG industry preferred.

	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Knowledge of procurement procedures and supply chain operations.
	Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP, and procurement software.
	Good analytical and cost-control skills.
	Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
	Attention to detail and problem-solving capability.


Preferred for Catering Industry:


	Knowledge of food commodities, packaging materials, housekeeping items, and kitchen equipment procurement.
	Experience in handling multiple sites / units and emergency purchasing requirements.

Purchase Officer (Associate) Job at Tetra Maritime




        
    

        
        Tetra Maritime is a leading Nigerian ship owner and operator, providing comprehensive and tailor-made solutions across the oil and gas supply chain, including upstream, midstream, and downstream.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Purchase Officer (Associate)

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full-time

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Purchase Officer is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing goods and services required by the organization while ensuring quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.
	The role involves vendor management, inventory coordination, and compliance with company procurement policies.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and evaluate suppliers based on quality, price, delivery, and service.
	Obtain quotations and negotiate pricing, payment terms, and contracts.
	Prepare and process Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs).
	Monitor order status and ensure timely delivery of materials.
	Coordinate with stores, operations, kitchen, and accounts departments.
	Maintain supplier records and develop strong vendor relationships.
	Compare market prices and conduct cost-saving initiatives.
	Ensure purchased items meet quality standards and specifications.
	Resolve supplier issues related to deliveries, shortages, and quality concerns.
	Maintain accurate procurement documentation and reports.
	Track inventory levels and support replenishment planning.
	Ensure compliance with company procurement policies and procedures.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Cost savings achieved through negotiations.
	On-time delivery performance.
	Vendor performance ratings.
	Inventory availability and stock control.
	Accuracy of procurement documentation.
	Reduction in purchase-related discrepancies.


Required Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
	2-5+ years of experience in purchasing / procurement.
	Experience in hospitality, catering, food service, or FMCG industry preferred.


Skills & Competencies:


	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Knowledge of procurement procedures and supply chain operations.
	Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP, and procurement software.
	Good analytical and cost-control skills.
	Excellent communication and coordination abilities.
	Attention to detail and problem-solving capability.


Preferred for Catering Industry:


	Knowledge of food commodities, packaging materials, housekeeping items, and kitchen equipment procurement.
	Experience in handling multiple sites / units and emergency purchasing requirements.

Quantitative Analyst Job at Tetra Maritime




        
    

        
        Tetra Maritime is a leading Nigerian ship owner and operator, providing comprehensive and tailor-made solutions across the oil and gas supply chain, including upstream, midstream, and downstream.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quantitative Analyst

Job Location: Lagos 

Description
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are looking for a quantitatively minded analyst to help scale our market intelligence and decision-making capabilities across tanker and dry bulk markets.
	This role sits at the intersection of data, markets, and strategy—focusing on identifying mispricing, improving market timing, and strengthening risk and performance frameworks.


Requirements
Mispricing Detection:


	Operate and extend our “live terminal” of S&P and TC-in/out opportunities
	Pressure-test breakeven, valuation, and forward-curve assumptions behind deals
	Build quantitative cases for or against opportunities
	Scale evaluation from a handful of opportunities to hundreds per week


Market Timing:


	Co-develop models to anticipate peaks and troughs in core markets (TD20, TD25, TD3)
	Frame forecasts probabilistically (distributions vs point estimates)
	Translate model outputs into actionable decisions across chartering, hedging, and S&P timing


Risk & Exposure Analysis:


	Quantify fleet exposure under different market scenarios
	Evaluate TC-in/TC-out strategies and derivatives overlays
	Build frameworks for sell/hold decisions and opportunity cost analysis


Performance Attribution:


	Measure outcomes of decisions on a like-for-like basis
	Distinguish between decision quality and market-driven outcomes
	Feed insights back into models to continuously improve performance


Tooling & Data:


	Curate and expand proprietary datasets and analytical tools
	Develop and refine models to support decision-making
	Leverage AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate output and insight generation


Candidate Profile
Quantitative Mindset:


	Strong grounding in regression, time-series analysis, probability, and machine learning
	Ability to reason under uncertainty and validate model assumptions
	Background in statistics, econometrics, finance, or quantitative research preferred


Shipping Market Knowledge:


	Experience or strong interest in shipping markets
	Background in brokerage, ownership, funds, or consultancy is a plus
	Market intuition valued alongside technical capability


Technical Skills:


	Working proficiency in Python and SQL
	Ability to read, modify, and deploy analytical code
	Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code)


Builder’s Mindset:


	Comfortable iterating quickly from hypothesis to prototype
	Willing to discard and rebuild approaches as needed
	Focused on impact over perfection


Experience:


	3–5 years in a markets-focused analytical role
	(e.g., shipping research, commodities/equities research, quant/systematic trading, fund analytics, or similar)

  "description": "Vestates was born on the 19th March 2013 as a private Limited Liability company, to launch out into the real estate and property management services space. Our aim over the years has been to provide complete real estate services. These include the sale and lease of residential and commercial properties, and long-term property management within Nigeria and Internationally.

From our early days of operation, we have focused on using technology to compete and create a niche for ourselves in the Nigerian real estate industry. Unfortunately, we had to step down to a more analogue approach if we were to work with other stakeholders in the real estate space in Nigeria. We dare say that, Vestates was ahead of its time in that regard.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative &amp; Sales Officer

Job Location: Wuse 2, Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: Sales &amp; Lettings

Role Summary


	We are looking for a highly organized, rational, and system-driven individual to serve as the operational backbone of our department, ensuring flawless execution in our current agency business while laying the administrative groundwork for our development expansion.
	Vestates Limited is looking for an Administrative Sales Officer to act as the planning, organizational, and administrative backbone of the Sales and Lettings department.
	The candidate will manage the operational engine including brief tracking, financial settlements, and regulatory compliance while actively driving revenue through direct sales.
	Crucially, the candidate will ensure that the data, processes, and relationships established today are scalable enough to support the department&#39;s upgrade into a fully-fledged Business Unit capable of handling off-plan sales and Joint Venture (JV) developments.


Key Responsibilities
Operational Control, Planning &amp; Financial Tracking (40%):


	Departmental Backbone &amp; Planning: Serve as the central planning hub for the department. Organize workflows, manage the team&#39;s schedules, and ensure all administrative processes run seamlessly to support the sales team.
	Brief &amp; Transaction Tracking: Monitor the lifecycle and performance of all briefs and transactions handled by the sales and lettings team. Track conversion rates, identify bottlenecks, and ensure no lead or brief falls through the cracks.
	Funds &amp; Contract Settlement: Meticulously track all Tenant and Landlord contracts. Monitor inflows and outflows to ensure optimal performance, accurate funds tracking, and timely commission/rent settlements to all stakeholders.
	Regulatory &amp; Agency Liaison: Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with regulatory and documentation agencies (e.g., FCDA, Ministry of Housing and Urban Development, AGIS, and relevant local councils). Use these relationships to fast-track enquiries, title verifications, and necessary approvals.


Sales, Lettings &amp; Client Experience (40%):


	Client Engagement &amp; Viewings: Conduct professional property viewings for lettings and secondary market sales across Abuja. Negotiate terms and close deals to meet monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
	Quality Assurance &amp; Exit Interviews: Conduct structured exit interviews with outgoing tenants. Gather objective feedback on property conditions, agency service, and market desires to identify areas for departmental and company-wide improvement.
	After-Sales Support: Act as the primary point of contact for post-sale/lease client queries, ensuring high retention, satisfaction, and referral rates.


Future-Proofing &amp; Business Unit Transition (20%):


	JV &amp; Development Admin Support: Assist in organizing the &quot;Data Room&quot; for Joint Ventures. Track and file JV sharing models, MoUs, and developer agreements, ensuring the administrative rigour required for large-scale development.
	Process Engineering (SOPs): Draft and refine Standard Operating Procedures for client onboarding, property handovers, brief tracking, and dispute resolution. Transition adhoc processes into scalable systems.
	Market Intelligence: Synthesize data from tenant exit interviews and sales tracking to provide the Head of Business with actionable insights on client preferences, pricing resistance, and location demands to inform future development feasibility.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIS)


	Operational: 100% accuracy and timeliness in funds tracking, landlord/tenant settlements, and brief performance reporting.
	Sales: Achievement of assigned monthly/quarterly lettings and sales revenue targets.
	Regulatory: Measurable reduction in turnaround time for document verifications and agency approvals due to established relationships.
	Transition: Successful documentation and rollout of at least 3 new SOPs (including the Exit Interview framework and Brief Tracking system) within the first 6 months.


Required Skills and Attributes


	BSc or HND in Business Administration, Estate Management, Public Administration, or a related field.
	2&ndash;4 years of experience in real estate administration, operations, or sales, preferably within the Abuja market.
	Proven track record of balancing backend operations (tracking, planning, compliance) with frontend sales targets.
	Proficiency in Real Estate Administration, Contract Management, and Funds Tracking.
	Advanced proficiency in MS Office (especially Excel for financial tracking and data analysis) and modern CRM software.
	Working knowledge of the Abuja real estate regulatory environment, land documentation processes, and property valuation principles.
	Planning &amp; Organizational Mastery: Exceptional ability to structure chaos. You must be the &quot;backbone&quot; that keeps the department organized, prioritized, and moving forward.
	Data Literacy: Ability to look at brief tracking and financial data, extract actionable insights, and report on the true health of the department.
	Stakeholder Navigation: Tact and diplomacy in dealing with government agencies, landlords, and tenants to fast-track processes without causing friction.
	High Integrity &amp; Objective Reporting: Uncompromising ethics in handling client funds and settlements. Ability to report brief performance and financial shortfalls without sugarcoating (Eliminating Confirmation Bias in departmental reporting).
	Pragmatic Problem Solving: Focus on actionable solutions. When regulatory agencies delay, you find a pragmatic, legal, and effective way to push the process forward.


Compensation
Salary is negotiable and will be based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated competencies.

Method of Applictaion&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to: vestates_hr@outlook.com using &ldquo;Sales Admin&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Marketing Officer Job at Westcare Specialist Hospital




        
    

        
        The idea to create Westcare Hospital group was conceived in 1997. This idea was brought to fruition in May 1998 when the first  hospital was founded and named Ilogbo central Hospital. The hospital was named after Ilogbo town near Ajangbadi, Ojo LGA of Lagos in which the hospital was situated.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Marketing Officer
Job Location: Egbeda, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities

	Promote the hospital’s healthcare services to individuals, corporate organisations, and other potential clients.
	Identify and engage potential clients through field visits, community outreach, and referrals.
	Visit businesses and other relevant establishments to create awareness of the hospital’s services.
	Distribute marketing materials and communicate information about available healthcare services.
	Build and maintain relationships with corporate clients, referral partners, and other prospective clients.
	Generate leads and follow up with prospects to ensurepatronage of the hospital’s services.
	Monitor and report marketingactivities and identify opportunities to increase awareness and patronage of the hospital’s services.
	Maintain records of marketing activities, client contacts, leads generated, and follow-up actions.
	Prepare and submit daily and weekly reports on field activities, leads generated, and client conversions.


Requirements


	Minimum of HND in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Previous experience in marketing, sales, or business development is required.
	Experience in healthcare marketing is an added advantage.
	Strong communication, persuasion, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to build and maintain professional relationships.
	Self-motivated, confident, and target-driven.
	Willingness to undertake regular field visits and work with minimal supervision.
